title: DEFCON 20: Bigger Monster, Weaker Chains: The National Security Agency and the Constitution
summary: A DEFCON 20 panel with NSA whistleblower William Binney, journalist James Bamford and ACLU lawyers on the NSA's mass collection of communications and its conflict with the Constitution.
why: HN points to it as a prescient talk that discussed, in 2012, much of what Snowden's leaks later confirmed.

quote.text: lot of the stuff which was later leaked by Snowden is discussed here
